title: Token Utility for On-Policy Distillation via Local Trust-Region Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.18883v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Token-selection methods for on-policy distillation (OPD) prioritize student-visited positions using diverse signals, including uncertainty, teacher-student disagreement, and mismatch direction. We instead derive token importance from the distillation objective itself: how much can each position's loss decrease under an equal local KL budget on the student's predictive distribution? The answer is the utility $s_t=g_t^\top F_t^\dagger g_t$, where $g_t$ is the logit gradient and $F_t$ is the categorical Fisher matrix. For reverse-KL it equals the student-weighted variance of the student-teacher log-probability ratio, and for forward-KL it equals the Pearson $\chi^2$ divergence, so the appropriate utility follows from the choice of objective. translated_title: 基于局部信赖域优化的在线策略蒸馏Token效用
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中的Token选择方法使用多种信号对学生访问过的位置进行优先级排序，这些信号包括不确定性、师生分歧和不匹配方向等。我们则从蒸馏目标本身推导token重要性：在学生预测分布上施加相等的局部KL预算时，每个位置的损失能降低多少？答案是效用 $s_t=g_t^\top F_t^\dagger g_t$，其中 $g_t$ 是logit梯度，$F_t$ 是类别Fisher矩阵。对于反向KL，该效用等于师生对数概率比的学生加权方差；对于正向KL，它等于Pearson $\chi^2$ 散度，因此合适的效用度量由目标函数的选择自然决定。在共享的训练检查点上，若干独立提出的准则，包括学生熵、KL分歧和TIP，均将其重要性集中在与所推导出的效用几乎相同的位置。
tldr: 该论文从蒸馏目标本身出发推导出token效用公式 $s_t=g_t^T F_t^\dagger g_t$，证明其在反向KL下等价于师生对数概率比的学生加权方差、在正向KL下等价于Pearson χ²散度，为在线策略蒸馏的token选择提供了统一且有原则的理论基础。
en_tdlr: The paper derives a token utility measure $s_t=g_t^T F_t^\dagger g_t$ directly from the distillation objective, showing that under reverse-KL it reduces to the student-weighted variance of the teacher-student log-probability ratio and under forward-KL to Pearson χ² divergence, thereby providing a principled and unified foundation for token selection in on-policy distillation.
